data.name: Task Bar Isekai
data.detailed_description:
Your taskbar is an isekai now.

Kenta Sato, programmer, stayed at the office until 3:47 AM one time too many. The update froze at 99%… and he was reborn in the Gekai (下界), the world beneath your taskbar, where computer glitches are monsters.

Task Bar Isekai is an idle ARPG that lives in a thin, transparent strip right above your Windows taskbar. Kenta fights on his own while you work, study or browse, and every time you glance down there's something new to grab.

Real Steam items. Real Steam Community Market.

Found something amazing? Take it to the Sealing Altar and turn your best gear into a real item in your Steam Inventory. Trade it with friends or sell it on the Steam Community Market.
  • Epic, Legendary, Mythic and ◆GLITCH◆ gear, shiny minions and cosmetic skins can all become Steam items.
  • Goddess Gifts: cosmetic drops that Steam hands out for playtime.
  • Limited weekly seals keep every item rare and valuable.
  • Sealed items become canonical versions: same name and Power, stats that scale to the owner's level, so they're easy to trade.
  • Changed your mind? Withdraw an item from Steam back into the game.

Loot. Forge. Break the seal.

  • 7 rarities, from Common to Mythic and the ultra-rare ◆GLITCH◆ series, with 17 unique powers like Ctrl+Z, Alt+F4 and sudo.
  • Forge up to +15 with Protection Ofuda, fuse 5 duplicates into 1 item of the next rarity, and reforge your affixes.
  • Bosses seal the way (封) until your gear is strong enough. Slow, satisfying progression with no resets: every upgrade counts.

Made to stay open

  • Bosses break out of the strip and onto your desktop. Click them to strike with lightning for 5× damage.
  • A golden Wandering Boss shows up every hour, on the hour.
  • Watch Chests fall from the top of your screen, but only while the game is open (folded counts too).
  • Vigil: +5% gold, XP and loot for every 30 minutes in a row, up to +100%.
  • Ponpoko, the tanuki merchant, sets up shop with deals straight out of the Recycle Bin.
  • Golden critters, combos, Fever (フィーバー!) and ultimates with anime cut-ins.
  • Move your mouse while you work to charge Kenta's Ki.
  • Offline progress at 25% (up to 8 hours). The good stuff happens while it's open.

An isekai story with heart (and a terrible boss)

70 story scenes with portraits: the scatterbrained Desktop Goddess who lives next to your clock, Mika the cache witch, Gonzo the sysadmin monk, Master Neko, Ponpoko… and Tanaka-bucho, who still wants that report on his desk by 9:00.
  • 4 difficulties × 5 acts × 10 stages, plus the endless Leviathan's Tower.
  • 3 heroes with skins, 15 enemies with elites and shinies, 6 bosses, minions, a Camp with 6 buildings, Guild quests, a Goddess Calendar, a Zukan and 66 in-game achievements.
  • New systems unlock bit by bit, so it never overwhelms you on day one.

Never in your way

  • Transparent, always on top and docked to your taskbar. Clicks outside the strip go straight to your desktop.
  • Fold it with one click or from the tray icon. Kenta keeps farming.
  • Light on your PC: 15/30/60 FPS, toggleable effects and Ghost Mode.

data.short_description: Kenta worked himself to death at 3:47 AM… and was reborn under your taskbar. An idle ARPG that fights while you work: loot, forge to +15, beat bosses that break out onto your desktop, and seal your best drops as real Steam items to trade or sell on the Steam Community Market.
data.supported_languages: Inglês, Espanhol (Espanha), Japonês, Francês, Alemão, Português (Brasil), Chinês simplificado, Chinês tradicional

pc_requirements.minimum:
Mínimos:
  • Sistema Operativo: Windows 10
  • Processador: Intel Core i3-3220 / AMD A6-5400K
  • Memória: 1 GB de RAM
  • Placa gráfica: Intel HD Graphics 4000 / GeForce GT 630 / Radeon HD 7570
  • Espaço no disco: Requer 120 MB de espaço livre
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recomendados:
  • Sistema Operativo: Windows 10
  • Processador: Intel Core i5-4460 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memória: 2 GB de RAM
  • Placa gráfica: GeForce GTX 750 Ti / Radeon RX 460
  • Espaço no disco: Requer 120 MB de espaço livre
